# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Real Bestie Dotcom Tycoon`, a portrait-first browser idle tycoon simulator based on this prompt:

> Idle. A satirical game inspired by vaporwave Y2K internet culture built around tycoon play, with creative, cozy, customizable energy, stress relief session design, search-friendly hooks like tycoon, idle, simulator, aesthetics like decora kei, y2k, kidcore, and meme-tone cues such as real, bestie. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The protected mechanics are an endless mobile idle clicker: tap a central mascot target to earn currency, fill a charge/vibe meter by +5 per accepted tap, let charge decay over time, trigger a temporary 5x rush mode at 100 charge, receive passive income once per second from an auto-upgrade, and buy five upgrade tracks with the original formulas. Preserve the no-fail cozy session design.

The presentation should be a satirical Y2K vaporwave desktop-pet micro-mall. The focal actor is a decora kei desktop pet/web shrine. HUD language uses Clout, Vibe, Real Bestie Rush, Tycoon Shoppe, Sticker Tap, Autoposter Bot, Chill Buffer, Lucky Meme Lens, and Bestie Rush Time. Use browser-native procedural canvas/CSS visuals: floating windows, checker grids, stickers, hearts, cursors, smileys, chunky outlined UI, and readable one-thumb mobile controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile idle/incremental clicker with canvas feedback and a shop drawer
- objective: tap the central core to earn energy, buy upgrades, build passive income, and trigger temporary high-output hyper mode
- input model: click/tap start button, click/tap central canvas target, click/tap shop and upgrade buttons
- core loop: earn currency by tapping, charge a meter, occasionally enter 5x hyper mode, spend currency on five upgrade tracks, gain idle income over time, repeat endlessly
- fail/friction state: no loss or win state; friction is insufficient currency, charge decay, and waiting for passive income

## Protected mechanics
- Central target distance hit test and one-thumb tap interaction.
- Tap gain formula: base click power multiplied by charge/hyper and critical modifiers.
- Charge +5 per accepted tap, decay based on stabilizer level, and 100-charge hyper trigger.
- Hyper duration formula and 5x multiplier semantics.
- Passive income every one second based on auto level.
- Five upgrade tracks, starting levels, costs, cost growth, and effect formulas.
- Endless low-pressure idle progression with no added fail state.

## Remixed target
`Real Bestie Dotcom Tycoon` reinterprets the same protected loop as a cozy satirical Y2K internet micro-mall. The player taps a customizable desktop-pet mascot to mint clout coins, buys decora/kidcore web-shop upgrades, rides Real Bestie Rush when the vibe meter fills, and watches a procedural vaporwave desktop scene evolve while the rules remain mechanically faithful.
